summary: Implementation matches the plan. New src/awf/service/support_bundle.py provides telemetry-free redacted bundle collection, disk write, and repeatability. CLI --bundle option added to awf service doctor with artifact path output and fail-path guidance pointing to the bundle and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml. All 7 required unit tests (5 in test_support_bundle.py and 2 in test_cli.py) are present and pass; the Pytest log shows 4062 passed. Mypy passes with no issues. Ruff errors are pre-existing in untouched files only.
